messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — ACME (renewal due in 6w) pushing for 30% uplift + asking for POC extension to validate dedicated node performance. They've started a security questionnaire too. Need deal desk sign-off on a rate exception and commit change. @samir can you advise next steps? :eyes:

samir: Thanks — can you drop the current numbers? do we have ARR, current commit, requested commit? need both for deal desk.

maria: Current: `ARR = $480k`, current committed tokens = `5M/month`. They're asking for `7M/month` for 12 months and want the standard rate reduced from `*$0.025/token*` to `*$0.0175/token*` in the first year. POC: extend 30 days with dedicated capacity during the trial window. CS wants clear rollback if perf doesn't meet SLOs.

julia: CSM note — they saw a 2.2x latency in tail on our hosted plan for long context. If we give dedicated pool for POC, ops will need a short runbook and KPIs. We should require a POC acceptance checklist.

kevin: From SE — to validate dedicated perf we need: 1) model + quantization config, 2) sample workload with typical prompt distribution, 3) steady-state concurrency target. If they want 7M tokens/month commit, we can propose a staged ramp: `5M -> 6M -> 7M` over 3 months, with price break applied when each milestone is hit.

lina: Security update — Acme's vendor questionnaire is mostly standard, but they flagged encryption-at-rest + BYOK for keys. Private deployment required for certain datasets. We can offer KMS integration but BYOK will need legal + infra effort (estimate 3-4 weeks). Also need SOC2 artifact share.

samir: Deal desk checklist: need (a) proposed revised ratecard, (b) commit timeline, (c) legal flag (BYOK), (d) revenue protection language for POC. I can fast-track if revenue delta < $100k vs baseline; beyond that needs director approval.

maria: Revenue delta calc: baseline year = `480k`, requested pricing at 7M tokens @ 0.0175 would net ~`$735k` ARR (est). Delta = `~$255k`. So director approval needed. We may offset by shortening the flat discount to 9 months and reverting to standard afterwards.

samir: Ok, request to deal desk: I'm creating the ticket. @dealbot please open a rate-exception with the details.

dealbot: Created RD-5421 — "ACME renewal rate exception: 7M commit, tiered ramp, BYOK flag" Assigned to Samir, SLA 72h. Link: https://dealdesk.internal/rd/5421

kevin: To speed technical sign-off, I'm preparing an SE runbook and POC acceptance checklist. Draft snippet below:

```
POC checklist:
- Target model: redwood/opt-2.7b-q4
- Token mix & sample trace attached
- Latency SLO: p95 < 220ms on 8-token generation
- Throughput: sustain 400 reqs/min
- Success: <1% error rate, perf improvement vs hosted baseline
```

julia: I can own POC coordination and acceptance. Also asking for an email from Acme committing to instrumentation and sample traffic by start date.

maria: For pricing play — propose compromise: new rate `0.020/token` for months 1-6 on ramp, then `0.0225/token` months 7-12, with a 12-month commit at 7M. That drops delta to ~`$120k`. @samir is that approvable by director or do we need VP?

samir: That looks reasonable. Director approval still required but under threshold for expedited review. I'll attach ACV sensitivity to the ticket.

lina: Regarding BYOK: we can offer a connector option but need legal sign-off. If they accept managed KMS (no BYOK) we can save 3 weeks. Recommend offering both as optional add-on.

maria: Thanks all. Next steps: @samir push to deal desk (RD-5421), @kevin finish runbook today, @julia collect sample traffic + confirm acceptance criteria with Acme, @lina prep list of artifacts for SOC2 + KMS options. Ping me when deal desk updates or if director wants different pricing. :thumbsup:

samir: Will update ticket and flag director. ETA 48h.
